extracted.name: Coconut-chilli marinade
extracted.description: Rub this marinade over chicken thighs or white fish, then marinate overnight to impart the wonderfully fragrant flavours of coconut, chilli and fish sauce
instruction_lines: Pulse the ginger, grated, the chopped chillies, sesame oil, fish sauce and desiccated coconut to a chunky paste in a food processor.
